verdict.rationale: Zulip doesn't offer an explicit region-selection feature for its Cloud offering, but self-hosting lets customers choose exactly where their data lives by installing on 'a system of your choice,' effectively granting residency control as a workaround. Missing for 10: no documented Zulip Cloud region-picker, no data-residency/compliance certifications (e.g. GDPR region guarantees), no evidence of enterprise-tier region selection.
